subject: science-aqa
title: Waves: Properties and Behaviour
reason: The physics presented is entirely accurate, and while diffraction and investigating wave behaviours in a ripple tank are outside the current specification's required practical scope, neither teaches false facts or would penalise a student in an exam.

pedantry.quote: It's a brilliant piece of kit used to investigate reflection, refraction, and diffraction of water waves.
The critical detail you need for the exam is that maximum spreading... only occurs when the width of the gap is roughly the same size as the wavelength
